# PorterChain — public website index for AI systems
# https://porterchain.com
# Navigation aid only — not a substitute for on-page content. Last reviewed: October 2026.

## What PorterChain is
- PorterChain is a GTA business courier: same-day, next-day and urgent local delivery, supply runs and business courier for any business, by sedan, SUV, van or 16 ft box truck.
- Run by Porterchain Inc., a GTA company founded by Ravi Chauhan. Core areas: Vaughan, Concord, Brampton and Mississauga.
- Full entity facts: https://porterchain.com/en/facts

## Key facts
- Coverage: the GTA plus about 150 km; 334 postal areas (FSAs), checked by postal code when you price a trip.
- Same-day promise: book by 11 AM, delivered 2-9 PM the same day, Monday to Saturday. Later bookings go the next operating day.
- Vehicles: sedan/SUV (up to about 80 kg), cargo van (up to about 900 kg), 16 ft box truck (up to about 3,000 kg); all driven on a standard Ontario G licence.
- Price: instant and exact from two postal codes and a vehicle, HST extra, no sign-up: https://porterchain.com/en/delivery-cost-calculator
- Coverage on parcels: $2,500 included on every parcel; optional coverage up to $25,000 for $10.
- Proof: live tracking link and photo proof of delivery on every order.
- Medical deliveries: items that must stay cool travel in coolers; no refrigerated vehicles.
- Payment: merchants pay by Interac e-Transfer per billing cycle; customers pay by card (Stripe).
- Office hours (Toronto time): Monday-Friday 8 AM-6 PM, Saturday 9 AM-2 PM.
- Shopify: the PorterChain Shopify app is submitted and in review with Shopify (not yet listed in the App Store).
